description: Harden the CAM-363 plan-preflight stderr surface: single-definition combineStreams helper, real-boundary makePreflightSpawnFn extraction, and an explicit both-streams-empty contract.

officialDocsConsulted.summary: Confirms Bun.spawnSync returns SyncSubprocess with `stdout: Buffer | undefined` and `stderr: Buffer | undefined` (NOT ReadableStream, unlike async Bun.spawn) plus `exitCode: number`. The union with `undefined` is exactly why the existing `r.stdout instanceof Buffer ? new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout) : ''` guard is required and must be preserved verbatim in the extracted factory: `r.stdout.toString()` would throw on the undefined case that Bun's own types permit. `cwd` is a documented top-level option on SpawnOptions.OptionsObject and applies to spawnSync. No deprecations affecting this usage.

userStories.title: Extract combineStreams helper to give stderr-first ordering one definition point
userStories.description: As a cam operator diagnosing a halted loop, I need the stderr-first stream-combination logic defined exactly once and directly unit-tested, so that a reversal at any of the four failure sites fails a test instead of silently burying the real verdict behind banner chatter.
acceptanceCriteria: AC1 (single definition point): the duplicated filter expression survives at exactly one place in src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts. Returns 4 on main, so this oracle fails today. [oracle: test "$(grep -c 'filter((s) => s.trim().length > 0)' src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts)" -eq 1]

AC2 (all four sites converted): `combineStreams(` occurs exactly 5 times in src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts: one definition plus the four call sites (git-checkout-main, git-pull, typecheck, bun-test). A partial conversion yields a different count and fails. [oracle: test "$(grep -c 'combineStreams(' src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts)" -eq 5]
AC3a (helper is exported): [oracle: grep -q 'export function combineStreams' src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts]
AC3b (helper is imported by name into the test file): [oracle: grep -q 'combineStreams' test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight.test.ts]

AC4a (ordering assertion exists at the definition point): the test file contains a direct assertion that combineStreams('ERRLINE', 'OUTLINE').split('\n')[0] equals 'ERRLINE'. [oracle: grep -q 'ERRLINE' test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight.test.ts]
AC4b (ordering assertion passes): [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight.test.ts]

AC5 (single-stream cases, strict equality not toContain): direct unit tests assert combineStreams('', 'OUT') === 'OUT' and combineStreams('ERR', '') === 'ERR', with no leading or trailing newline in either case. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight.test.ts]
AC6a (both-streams-empty at the helper): a direct unit test asserts combineStreams('', '') === '' strictly. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight.test.ts]

AC11a (out-of-scope guard, clean-tree step untouched): src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts still contains the exact clean-tree return line, stdout-only and byte-identical. [oracle: grep -q "return { ok: false, step: 'clean-tree', detail: status.stdout.trim() };" src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts]

AC11c (out-of-scope guard, stderr stays required): the PlanPreflightSpawnFn declaration still types stderr as a required string, never `stderr?: string`. [oracle: ! grep -q 'stderr?: string' src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
Lint spine green (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes:
Files: src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts (edit), test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight.test.ts (edit).

Signature: `export function combineStreams(stderr: string, stdout: string): string`. Export is REQUIRED (not module-private like the file's own pruneMergedCamBranches precedent at :145) so the helper can be unit-tested directly. stderr is the FIRST parameter, mirroring the stderr-first ordering.

The four call sites are at plan-preflight.ts :86 (git-checkout-main), :94 (git-pull), :117 (typecheck), :128 (bun-test). Verified on main: the filter expression greps to 4, combineStreams to 0, so AC1/AC2 both fail today as required.

WHY ORDERING IS LOAD-BEARING (do not lose this in the refactor): `detail` reaches the operator through truncatePreflightDetail (src/supervisor/plan-preflight-marker.ts:135-139), which renders FIRST LINE ONLY plus a ` (+N more)` suffix, consumed at src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts:1607. A stdout-first combination buries the actual verdict behind tens of kilobytes of banner chatter, which is exactly what made the original incident undiagnosable.

RELOCATE, DO NOT DELETE, the four bespoke per-site justification comments (L83-85, L93, L114-116, L124-127): collapse them into one explanation on the helper body.

AC2 COUNT GOTCHA: the oracle counts the literal `combineStreams(` string across the whole file. If you write a JSDoc block on the helper that mentions `combineStreams(...)` in prose, the count becomes 6 and AC2 fails. Reference the helper without trailing parens in prose (write `combineStreams` not `combineStreams()`).

AC4 MUTATION CEREMONY (guidance, deliberately NOT an acceptance criterion since the ceremony itself is unverifiable after the fact): after writing the ordering test, locally reverse the two operands inside the helper body, run `bun test test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight.test.ts`, confirm you observe RED, then restore before committing. This proves the assertion is not vacuous. The AC oracles verify the restored assertion; the ceremony is for your own confidence.

ORDERING IS CURRENTLY UNGUARDED AT TWO OF FOUR SITES: plan-preflight.test.ts:120-129 (git-checkout-main) and :154-165 (git-pull) assert only toContain(...) with stdout empty, which passes identically under EITHER ordering. Only :255 and :314 use .split('\n')[0]. That asymmetry is the entire reason this story exists; do not assume the existing suite protects you.

Do NOT weaken the required `stderr` field on PlanPreflightSpawnFn (declared at plan-preflight.ts:31-34) to make anything easier. CAM-363 made it required deliberately; this repo has TWICE shipped bugs from fixtures encoding a wrong process model (CAM-359, CAM-364). If a fixture does not compile, fix the fixture.

Keep plan-preflight.ts PURE: it contains no Bun.spawnSync today and must not gain one (that is US-002's new sibling module).

Neither plan-preflight.ts nor its test file has a scripts/file-size-budget.json entry; do not add any.

userStories.title: Extract the production preflight spawn closure into a real-boundary-tested sibling module
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need the sole production PlanPreflightSpawnFn implementation extracted out of the sidecar into a named, exported factory covered by tests that hit a real subprocess, so that the exact seam where CAM-363's stderr drop hid can no longer regress undetected.
acceptanceCriteria: AC7a (new module exists and exports the factory): src/supervisor/plan-preflight-spawn.ts exports makePreflightSpawnFn. [oracle: grep -q 'export function makePreflightSpawnFn' src/supervisor/plan-preflight-spawn.ts]

AC7b (typed against the imported type, not redeclared or widened): the new module imports PlanPreflightSpawnFn from ./plan-preflight.ts and does not redeclare it. [oracle: grep -q 'PlanPreflightSpawnFn' src/supervisor/plan-preflight-spawn.ts && ! grep -q 'type PlanPreflightSpawnFn =' src/supervisor/plan-preflight-spawn.ts]

AC8a (sidecar no longer inlines the closure): the inline Bun.spawnSync literal is gone from src/commands/sidecar.ts. Returns 1 on main, so this fails today. [oracle: test "$(grep -c 'Bun.spawnSync(\[bin, ...args\]' src/commands/sidecar.ts)" -eq 0]
AC8b (sidecar imports the factory): [oracle: grep -q "from '../supervisor/plan-preflight-spawn.ts'" src/commands/sidecar.ts]

AC8c (the threaded value is the RESULT OF CALLING the factory, not merely an import): the invocation shape makePreflightSpawnFn(cwd) appears in src/commands/sidecar.ts. This pins the call, not the import: a bare import with the value still wired from something else fails. [oracle: grep -q 'makePreflightSpawnFn(cwd)' src/commands/sidecar.ts]

AC9 (REAL boundary, no fakes): a test imports makePreflightSpawnFn from src/supervisor/plan-preflight-spawn.ts and calls the returned function against a REAL subprocess (no injected fake, no hand-copied equivalent closure), asserting all four of: (a) a command writing a known literal to stderr and nothing to stdout yields stderr containing that literal and stdout.trim() === ''; (b) the mirror case for stdout; (c) a command writing to BOTH streams yields both decoded and non-empty; (d) a non-zero-exiting command yields the matching non-zero exitCode. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight-spawn.test.ts]

AC10 (cwd is honored, non-vacuously): a test creates a real temp directory, calls makePreflightSpawnFn(thatTmpDir), spawns a command printing the working directory, and asserts the decoded stdout resolves to that temp directory. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight-spawn.test.ts]

AC11b (out-of-scope guard, loopSpawnFn untouched): no ADDED or REMOVED diff line mentions loopSpawnFn. Scoping to '^[+-]' lines is required: a naive `! git diff | grep -q` would false-fail whenever the hunk carries a loopSpawnFn context line. Verified empirically that this oracle passes on an unmodified tree AND on a correct extraction, and goes RED (exit 1) when the loopSpawnFn body is edited. [oracle: ! git diff main -- src/commands/sidecar.ts | grep -E '^[+-]' | grep -q 'loopSpawnFn']
AC12a (sidecar NET LOSES lines): src/commands/sidecar.ts is strictly shorter than main's 3437 lines. [oracle: test "$(wc -l < src/commands/sidecar.ts)" -lt 3437]

AC12b (budget ceiling NOT raised): no added or removed line in scripts/file-size-budget.json mentions sidecar.ts. If check:all reports the ceiling newly violated, the extraction was not actually performed: fix the extraction, do not raise the ceiling. [oracle: ! git diff main -- scripts/file-size-budget.json | grep -E '^[+-]' | grep -q 'sidecar.ts']
AC11c (out-of-scope guard, stderr stays required): [oracle: ! grep -q 'stderr?: string' src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
Lint spine green (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes:
Files: src/supervisor/plan-preflight-spawn.ts (NEW), src/commands/sidecar.ts (edit), test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight-spawn.test.ts (NEW).

The closure to extract is at src/commands/sidecar.ts:2638-2646 (inside makeProductionPlanPhaseFn), currently threaded as `preflightSpawnFn` into runProductionPlanPhaseWithReplan at :2658-2660. It has ZERO coverage today: no test file imports or names preflightSpawnFn, and every unit test injects the string-returning fake at test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight.test.ts:45-55.

Signature: `export function makePreflightSpawnFn(cwd: string): PlanPreflightSpawnFn`, importing the type from './plan-preflight.ts'.

PRESERVE THE BUFFER GUARD EXACTLY: `r.stdout instanceof Buffer ? new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout) : ''` and the same for stderr. Do NOT 'improve' it to `r.stdout.toString()`. Confirmed against the official Bun spawn docs fetched during planning: SyncSubprocess types stdout/stderr as `Buffer | undefined`, so the non-Buffer branch is reachable per Bun's own types and toString() would throw there.

FLAT SIBLING-MODULE LAYOUT is the directory's convention (44 flat domain modules, e.g. plan-preflight-marker.ts). There is no utils/helpers module in src/supervisor/ and you must not create one. The factory goes in the NEW sibling module, never inside plan-preflight.ts, which must stay pure and injectable.

REAL-I/O TEST PATTERN (repo invariant, see scripts/cam/patterns.md 'Real-git integration test pattern' line 70 and the CAM-90 entries at :288/:290 for why fakes miss this class): a test asserting only that a mock was called is documentation, not verification. Bun.spawnSync must ACTUALLY EXECUTE in every AC9 case.

macOS has NO `timeout` binary. Prefer `bun -e '...'` or `sh -c '...'` for deterministic stream writes rather than tool-specific output formats. For AC10 use a real temp dir via mkdtempSync over tmpdir() and clean it up in afterEach with rmSync({ recursive: true, force: true }).

AC10 NON-VACUITY: on macOS, tmpdir() paths are commonly symlinked (/var -> /private/var), so a raw string compare of `pwd` output against the mkdtemp path can false-fail. Resolve both sides through realpathSync before comparing, and make sure a DIFFERENT cwd would change the result.

FILE-SIZE: sidecar.ts sits at 3437 lines against a ceiling of 3438 (one line of headroom, raised by CAM-363). This change deletes a 9-line inline closure and replaces it with one call plus one import, so it must REDUCE the file. If you want to raise the ceiling, the extraction is wrong.

AC11b ORACLE PROVENANCE: the previous plan round used `git diff main -- src/commands/sidecar.ts | grep -q 'loopSpawnFn' && false || true`, which the auditor BLOCKED as self-nullifying: the `&& false || true` tail forces exit 0 on every input. Confirmed empirically (exit=0 on an unmodified tree AND exit=0 with the loopSpawnFn body deliberately mutated). The replacement above was verified to go RED under that same mutation. Do not revert to the old shape.

loopSpawnFn (sidecar.ts:2628-2636) carries the IDENTICAL stderr drop but is a DIFFERENT code path with a different type (LoopSpawnFn has no stderr field) and is deliberately deferred. Do not touch it.

userStories.title: Pin the both-streams-empty contract through runPlanPreflight and real truncatePreflightDetail
userStories.description: As a cam operator, I need the case where a failing step emits neither stdout nor stderr pinned end-to-end, so that a step reported with NO verdict (the original symptom shape CAM-363 existed to eliminate) is a test failure rather than a silent regression.
acceptanceCriteria: AC6b (pinned at the runPlanPreflight result): the existing first-fail-only test at test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight.test.ts:114-118 (or a sibling on the same input shape) asserts, for a step failing with { exitCode: 1, stdout: '', stderr: '' }, that result.ok === false AND result.detail === '' strictly, in addition to the existing calls.length assertion. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight.test.ts]

AC6c (pinned through the REAL truncate function): a test asserts truncatePreflightDetail('') === '' using the real function imported from src/supervisor/plan-preflight-marker.ts, not a reimplementation. [oracle: grep -q 'plan-preflight-marker.ts' test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight.test.ts]
AC6c-pass (that assertion passes): [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight.test.ts]

AC13 (test count strictly grew): the total passing test count is STRICTLY GREATER than main's baseline of 5179. This change only adds test declarations and removes none. The oracle extracts the 'N pass' figure from bun test output and compares numerically: `bun test` alone cannot decide this, since its exit code is identical whether the count rose, stayed flat, or fell. Note bun writes the summary to stderr, hence the 2>&1. [oracle: test "$(bun test 2>&1 | grep -oE '^\s*[0-9]+ pass' | grep -oE '[0-9]+' | head -1)" -gt 5179]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
Lint spine green (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes:
Files: test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight.test.ts (edit only). Depends on US-001 for the combineStreams('', '') === '' assertion (AC6a), which is the helper-level third of this same contract.

WHY THIS MATTERS: when a failing step produces neither stream, detail is the empty string, which renders through truncatePreflightDetail as an empty tail. The marker/narration then shows a step with NO verdict, which is the ORIGINAL SYMPTOM SHAPE CAM-363 existed to eliminate. The existing test at :114-118 already constructs exactly that input but asserts only calls.length.

FAKE-FALLBACK GOTCHA (important): the fake at test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight.test.ts:45-55 has a default-fill fallback returning { exitCode: 0, stdout: '', stderr: '' } when its response array is exhausted. Make sure the empty detail under test comes from the EXPLICIT failing response, not accidentally from that fallback: otherwise the test passes for the wrong reason and pins nothing.

truncatePreflightDetail is at src/supervisor/plan-preflight-marker.ts:135-139. Note its early return: `if (rest.length === 0) return detail;` means ''.split('\n') yields [''] with rest empty, so it returns '' unchanged. Import the REAL function; a reimplementation in the test would pin nothing. There is an existing sibling test file, test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight-marker.test.ts, but AC6c's oracle greps plan-preflight.test.ts, so place the assertion there to keep the three-level contract (helper, result, truncate) readable in one file.

AC13 ORACLE PROVENANCE: the previous plan round attached [oracle: bun test] to the count claim, which the auditor BLOCKED because bun test decides only zero-failures: its exit code is identical whether the count rose, stayed flat, or fell. The extraction pipeline above was verified during planning (scoped run extracted N=30 correctly, and `test 30 -gt 31` returns 1, proving the comparison can go red). The 5179 baseline is the figure recorded in the issue spec.

RUN DISCIPLINE: do NOT run the full bun test suite repeatedly in parallel with other heavy work; the sidecar is live on this host. Scope test runs to test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight.test.ts while iterating, and run the full suite once at the gate (the AC13 oracle is that single full run).
